rulebook.title: IBJJF Rules Book / General Competition Guidelines / Competition Format Manual
rulebook.edition: Version 6.1, June 2024 (cover 'JUN.2024'; page footers 'VERSION 6.1 2024'; ibjjf.com/rules labels the same file 'Rule Book (v6.0)'; closing page reads 'VERSION 6.2'). Checked ibjjf.com/rules and ibjjf.com/books-videos on 2026-10-11: no newer edition listed. Companion 'Technical Fouls & Illegal Moves' poster dated 2024-01-01.
rulebook.locator: Article 6.2.3 (M), 'TABLE: Technical Fouls – Illegal Moves', p. 29; knee-reaping definition p. 32; 50/50 trapped-foot note p. 33; jumping closed guard 6.2.2 (W)

age_caveat: The table is organised by age division, not just belt: columns are 4–12, 13–15, 16–17 (all ranks, grouped with Adult–Master 7 white belts), Adult–Master 7 blue/purple, Adult–Master 7 brown/black (gi, plus Master no-gi), and Adult brown/black NO-GI — so heel hooks, knee reaping, knee-twisting locks and outward toe-hold pressure are legal ONLY in the Adult (not Master 30+) brown/black no-gi division, and 16–17-year-olds are restricted like white belts regardless of rank.
legend: Values are the lowest adult belt at which the technique is legal (white|blue|purple|brown|black), or 'never'. 'gi' = adult gi divisions; 'nogi' = adult no-gi divisions (Master no-gi follows the gi column).

rows.technique_class: straight ankle lock (straight foot lock / Achilles lock)
rows.note: Table row 3: banned only for 4–12 and 13–15. The only leg lock legal for adult white belts. See row 16 for the direction restriction.

rows.technique_class: straight foot lock, turning in the direction of the foot NOT under attack (toward the free leg)
rows.note: Row 16: illegal for 16–17, white, blue and purple; legal for brown/black in gi and no-gi.

rows.technique_class: toe hold
rows.note: Row 15. Estima lock is not named in the rulebook; it is a twisting foot lock and is treated by coaches as toe-hold class.

rows.technique_class: toe hold, applying outward pressure on the foot
rows.note: Row 20: illegal everywhere except Adult brown/black no-gi.

rows.technique_class: kneebar
calf slicer
bicep slicer
heel hook (inside or outside)
rows.note: Row 17: illegal in all gi divisions and all Master no-gi; legal only Adult brown/black no-gi (introduced 2021). Aoki lock has heel-hook mechanics and falls here.

rows.technique_class: locks twisting the knees (knee torsion e.g. Z-lock, rotational entanglement finishes)
rows.note: Row 18: same column pattern as heel hook.

rows.technique_class: knee reaping (reaping position / inside ashi / 'leg knot')
rows.note: Row 19; definition p. 32: thigh behind opponent's leg, calf across the body above the knee, foot past the vertical midline, pressure on the knee from outside-in while the attacked foot is trapped (between hip and armpit, by a grip, OR weight-bearing on the ground). Crossing the midline = severe foul (DQ); if either athlete has a submission hold it is a severe foul. For purple and below, if a legal crossed-leg seated position becomes a reap because one athlete stands, the referee stops and resets; for brown/black the fight is not interrupted.

rows.technique_class: submission techniques stretching the legs apart (banana split, electric chair, crotch ripper)
rows.note: Row 1: banned ONLY for 4–12-year-olds; legal in every adult belt in gi and no-gi.

rows.technique_class: choke with spinal lock
spinal lock without choke (neck crank, twister, can-opener-type cranks)
rows.note: Row 22: illegal in all divisions. Under-12 referees must additionally protect the spine (1.3.8).

rows.technique_class: Ezekiel / forearm choke using the sleeve
rows.note: Row 4: banned 4–12 and 13–15 only. (Gi-specific move; no-gi Ezekiel is not separately listed.)

rows.technique_class: frontal guillotine choke
omoplata
triangle pulling the head
arm triangle
lock inside the closed guard with legs compressing kidneys or ribs (body triangle / closed-guard squeeze)
wrist lock
single-leg takedown with attacker's head outside the opponent's body
rows.note: Row 11: prohibited through adult white but marked (**) 'athlete will not be penalized'; referee intervenes.

rows.technique_class: slam
scissor takedown (kani basami)
bending fingers backwards
grabbing the belt and throwing an attacker onto his head while defending a head-outside single leg
suplex landing the opponent on head or neck
rows.note: Row 26 / 6.2.3 (L): suplex itself allowed if head/neck are not driven into the mat.

rows.technique_class: strangling with hands around the neck or thumb on the windpipe (no gi material)
rows.note: 6.2.3 (I)–(J): severe foul in all divisions; blocking nose/mouth with hands also a severe foul.

rows.technique_class: jumping to closed guard on a standing opponent
rows.note: 6.2.2 (W): serious foul for under-15 (all belts) and ALL white belt age groups; legal from blue.

rows.technique_class: foot in the lapel behind the opponent's neck
